net.canarymod.hook.system

Class PermissionCheckHook

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.canarymod.hook.Hook
      • net.canarymod.hook.system.PermissionCheckHook

  • public final class PermissionCheckHook
extends Hook
    This hook is called after the PermissionProvider has resolved the permission, to alter the final outcome and eventually temporary allow a permission to a player

    Chris (damagefilter)
